purpose: Bounded mixed-time engineering DEV fit; no independent TEST or online replacement

data.train: old bank3 early72 + late48 bank2 task6 all24
data.development: analysis_development bank0 early72 + late48 bank5 task6 all24
data.prior_control_exposure: bank1 control previously seen; only new q labels held out

target: No physical fall from common source task1 through hypothetical pulseEND+3seconds; preparation falls negative, faults invalid

features.timing: Source prebranch observation, latest history frame; prove alignment with actual source physical state and first query. Initial candidate offsets are native tanh mapping of first pre-force queried latent, not future applied references.
features.scaling: Preserve native fixed scales/clipping; no fitted population normalizer
features.limitations: Latest frame only, not full hidden history; true simulation forward speed requires deployment estimator. Speed-state ablation still receives full-H75-derived candidate offsets; not pure speed-only or future-speed forecast.

architecture.output: one logit; sigmoid only for probability reporting

training.seed_aggregation: Report every seed and equal-weight mean predictions; do not pick best seed
training.prior: train no-fall fraction; clip only scoring probabilities to [1e-7,1-1e-7]
training.stop: Fixed6000 updates or nonfinite/engineering error; no implicit continuation
training.tensorboard: reuse project6006 when compatible; verify HTTP and run scalars before fit; no other project service interruption

metrics: ROC-AUC and PR-AUC only if both classes
same-source/prep/direction alpha-discordant group pair ranking with denominator
evaluation.uncertainty: descriptive groups; seeds are optimizer randomness, not independent physical states
evaluation.single_class: still report proper scores/confusion/prior; mark discrimination not identifiable
evaluation.online: No replacement or new controller rollouts; prediction performance distinct from selection gain

temporal_mix.bce_weighting: equal per sample among all96; no class weights
temporal_mix.role: seen engineering DEV; not independent TEST
